# Geist font source

- Package: `geist@1.7.2`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/vercel/geist-font>
- Asset: `dist/fonts/geist-sans/Geist-Variable.woff2`
- SHA-256: `a369fcf5628ea2aa4e1b9e2ec6a5b3624e365bda588e1f0f2f12b564f728fbb8`

Only the normal Geist Sans variable font is shipped. The app keeps native system
fallbacks for glyphs outside Geist and keeps third-party Google Sign-In and
Phosphor icon typography isolated from the application text stack.
